name: parallax-layers
title: Parallax Layers
description: A stack of layers that drift at different speeds as the scene scrolls past. Layers stay put under reduced motion.

props.name: layers
props.type: { id: string; content: ReactNode; depth: number; blur?: number; opacity?: number }[]
props.description: Layers from back to front. depth 0 stays put, 1 moves the full range.

props.name: container
props.description: Scrollable element that drives the motion. Defaults to the page.
